title: Tapered Web Frame And Open Binding Snowshoe
description: One newly authored whole static single snowshoe appearance. A continuous tapered oval tubular frame has an upturned front and carries two open crossed-cord web fields separated by a complete central binding plate. Whole front and rear crossbridges connect the binding plate to the perimeter. Two broad arched retention bands and a low rear heel cup leave the boot volume empty. Two full underside traction bars and four blunt finite-bottom teeth ground the object in the fixed display pose. Every contour, web span and binding profile newly authored together, not a tennis racket with its grip removed, a flattened glove or a skate with its wheels deleted. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre scale and Z up; one whole model, zero scenes. Static illustrative equipment only: no wearer or matched pair, walking or flotation simulation, snow contact, bindings operation, fit, traction, load, materials, manufacture or sports safety certification.
